title: Final release evaluation, validation definitions, and resumption integrity
scope: Finalize the reproducible Decoy-Free engineering/parity refactor after required ISB model-by-model and independent PXD001468 Moments parity. This phase does not claim that Decoy-Free is ready to replace a statistical default.

release_gate_semantics.eligible: All required evidence is evaluable and all release criteria pass.
release_gate_semantics.not_eligible: Evidence is complete, but one or more scientific or engineering criteria fail.
release_gate_semantics.not_evaluable: Required evidence is missing, invalid, unreadable, or cannot be linked to its declared calibration source.
release_gate_semantics.compatibility: eligible_for_statistical_default_change remains as a compatibility boolean and is true only when status is eligible.
fail_closed_changes: Missing result files are recorded in validation.missing_runs.json instead of aborting before reporting.
Malformed or unreadable result tables are recorded in validation.invalid_runs.json.
Every declared dataset-local parity stage/layer must have a comparison; external evidence cannot replace it.
A declared target-only calibration stage must exist; validation and TDC comparisons never fall back to a different stage.
Every release-candidate target-only result must have an evaluable transfer comparison and calibration quality gate.
Matched TDC evidence must exist before a workflow can be evaluated for a statistical default change.
Frozen baselines declared complete must be nonempty.

identification_definitions.common_filters: rank=1, label=1, non-contaminant, and unambiguous target/entrapment mapping
identification_definitions.psm: Distinct result-table PSM identity passing the stage/layer PSM threshold.
identification_definitions.peptide: Unmodified sequence after removing bracketed modifications and canonicalizing I/L.
identification_definitions.peptidoform: Sequence retaining bracketed modification annotations while canonicalizing unmodified I/L; uses the measured peptidoform ratio already represented by the workflow PSM ratio.
identification_definitions.coverage: All four counts are present in run summaries, parity comparisons, stage comparisons, target-only transfer, and matched TDC comparisons.

resume_identity: candidate-pool schema, stable-ID schema, search fingerprint, capability, count, and payload hash
MS2Rescore annotation-cache identity and payload integrity for annotated stages
checkpoint_and_cache_integrity.interruption_behavior: A checkpoint with status running is not resumed as complete.
checkpoint_and_cache_integrity.modified_output_behavior: A result or configuration hash mismatch invalidates the stage rather than silently resuming it.
checkpoint_and_cache_integrity.legacy_migration: Compatible Phase 1-8 checkpoints are migrated once after their existing identities and durable caches pass verification.

isb18.not_evaluable_reason: A matched TDC benchmark is missing.
isb18.engineering_note: ISB18 is the development parity dataset; its known Lower Order/Nokoi transfer and deferred-model results remain explicit and are not relabeled passed.

pxd001468_moments.not_evaluable_reason: A matched TDC benchmark is missing.

tests_added_or_extended: Missing and invalid audit inputs produce an evaluable=false report and durable evidence files.
Every declared parity stage/layer requires local evidence.
A missing declared calibration source cannot fall back to optimized or MS2Rescore.
Unmodified peptide and modification-retaining peptidoform counts are distinct and deterministic.
Candidate-pool workflow usage rejects a modified payload.
Running checkpoints and modified outputs are not eligible for resume.
Phase 8 default Ensemble fields remain serialization-compatible with frozen stage fingerprints.

verification.cargo_clippy_workspace_all_targets: completed with existing warning debt; -D warnings is not a release gate for this branch and currently reports longstanding lints across Sage core and CLI

deferred_models.lower_order: Artifact-reuse transfer remains unstable; refit parity remains valid.
deferred_models.msfdr: Annotated parity remains deferred pending environment reproduction or platform-robustness repair.
deferred_models.msfdr2_smix: Annotated parity remains deferred pending environment reproduction or platform-robustness repair.
deferred_models.nokoi: Portable artifact v1 and frozen parity remain incomplete.
deferred_models.ensemble: Optional and evaluable only when enough dataset-local experts pass all automatic gates.

pxd_scope.decision: No additional PXD model is required for this refactor.
